units.source_text: 六条妃子有时也暂回六条京极私邸。

en.t: Lady Rokujo sometimes also returned for a while to her private residence at Rokujo Kyogoku.

units.source_text: 但行踪秘密，源氏大将不得而知。

en.t: But her movements were kept secret, and Captain Genji had no way of knowing them.

units.source_text: 野宫乃斋戒之地，不便任意前去访问。

en.t: The Nonomiya was a place of purification and abstinence, so it was not convenient to go there freely for a visit.

units.source_text: 源氏大将有咫尺天涯之感，也只得蹉跎度日。

en.t: Captain Genji felt she was close at hand yet impossibly far away, and could only let the days pass in vain.

units.source_text: 正在此时，桐壶院患病了，虽非重症，却也时时发作，不胜其苦。

en.t: Just then, the Kiritsubo院 fell ill; though it was not a grave illness, it flared up from time to time and caused him great suffering.

units.source_text: 源氏大将为此心绪不宁，然而还是挂念六条妃子：

en.t: Captain Genji was unsettled by this, yet he still kept thinking of Lady Rokujo:

units.source_text: “让她恨我薄倖，毕竟对她不起。

en.t: “If I make her resent me as faithless, I will, after all, have wronged her.

units.source_text: 而且外人闻知，亦将谓我无情。”

en.t: And if outsiders hear of it, they too will say that I am heartless.”

units.source_text: 于是下个决心，前往野宫访问。

en.t: So he made up his mind and went to the Nonomiya to visit her.
